name: Steal
permanence: Stored abilities remain until deliberately released or replaced.
slot_rule: A core ability includes intrinsic sub-abilities, learned branches, and mastery ceiling at theft time.
replacement: Conscious confirmation required; released ability is gone until stolen again.

Ability_Theft.target_loss: temporary suppression by default; permanent removal requires rare explicit condition

HP_Siphon.effect: transfer vitality up to safe cap

CM_Siphon.restriction: cannot exceed CM max without overcharge check

guards: All stolen abilities still consume CM.
